village.name: Village
village.description: A peaceful village. You stand in the town square.

exits.text: Take the road to the Castle

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: A lively tavern filled with patrons. An old bartender nods at you.

loot.message: The bartender hands you a health potion.

forest.name: Dark Forest
forest.description: A dense forest. You notice something glinting in the undergrowth.

forest_search.name: Deep Forest
forest_search.description: You find a clearing with ancient ruins.

loot.message: You picked up an Iron Sword!

shop.name: Weapon Shop
shop.description: A small shop with various weapons on display.

shop_browse.name: Shop Interior
shop_browse.description: The shopkeeper smiles at you and offers a bow.

castle.name: Dark Castle
castle.description: A massive dark castle looms before you. This is the lair of the Dragon.

boss_arena.name: Dragon's Lair
boss_arena.description: You stand face to face with the mighty Dragon!

boss_fight.name: The Dragon
boss_fight.description: A fearsome dragon with scales of black stone.

stages.message: The dragon roars! Fire erupts from its mouth!
The dragon lunges forward with its claws!
The dragon beats its massive wings, creating a whirlwind!
You need to strike back! Use a weapon!
The dragon circles overhead. You need range!
With a final strike, the dragon falls!

victory.title: VICTORY!
victory.message:
You have defeated the Dragon and saved the realm!
The kingdom celebrates your heroic deeds!

defeat.title: DEFEAT
defeat.message:
You don't have the required item!
The dragon defeats you in combat.

Try again!
